final: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts), shares AS (SELECT c.college_id, c.player_count, CAST(c.player_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM college_counts AS c CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_count AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS value FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.player_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.player_count - m.value) FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_count AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL AND s.player_count > m.value
